annotation.title_clean: 商务部等7部门关于提质增效实施2026年消费品以旧换新政策的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Commerce and 6 Other Departments on Improving Quality and Efficiency in Implementing the 2026 Consumer Goods Trade-In Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部; 国家发展改革委; 工业和信息化部; 公安部; 财政部; 税务总局; 市场监管总局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice on implementing the 2026 consumer goods trade-in subsidy programme. It sets national subsidy standards for cars and appliances, gives localities autonomy, encourages subsidies for new-generation AI smart terminals under the 'AI+' initiative, and strengthens fraud prevention and oversight.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unified national subsidy standards for four areas: car scrappage, car replacement, six appliance types, four digital/smart products.
Localities may use matching funds for AI smart terminals aligned with the State Council 'AI+' action.
Subsidy categories to follow AI terminal intelligence grading standards.
Price filing, merchant list management, and real-name verification to prevent subsidy fraud.
Cross-department data sharing and complaint channels for supervision.
